title: CI: instrumented tests on a Gradle Managed Device
findings_note: .github/workflows/build.yml (unit tests only); S05, S10, S15, S35, S39 and S45 add instrumented tests that CI never runs
boundary: **Not in this slice:** writing new instrumented tests, third-party emulator actions, and running on more than one API level.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Six slices put their acceptance tests in `app/src/androidTest` (Room constraints, navigation, undo, accessibility). Today they run only when someone remembers `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest` on a device, so regressions in the data layer can merge unnoticed. Gradle Managed Devices are built into the Android Gradle Plugin, so this needs no new dependency.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None new. The job runs the existing `androidTest` suite (`TrackerDaoTest` from S05, `BackupCodecInstrumentedTest`, and later ones).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `app/build.gradle`, inside `android { testOptions { … } }`, declare one managed virtual device named `pixel6api34`: `device = "Pixel 6"`, `apiLevel = 34`, `systemImageSource = "aosp-atd"`. The DSL block name differs between AGP versions (`devices` with an explicit `ManagedVirtualDevice` type in older 8.x, `localDevices` in newer ones). Use the form documented at developer.android.com/studio/test/gradle-managed-devices for the AGP version in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Confirm the task exists with `./gradlew tasks --all | rg pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest`.
2. If `aosp-atd` has no image for API 34, use `systemImageSource = "aosp"` and record that with `slicer note S55`.
3. Run it locally once: `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest`. The first run downloads the system image. It must pass.
4. In `.github/workflows/build.yml` add a job `instrumented` (it runs in parallel with `build`) on `ubuntu-latest`:
   - `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-java@v4` (temurin 17), `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4`, as the `build` job does.
   - Enable KVM (GitHub's documented step):
     ```
     echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
     sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
     sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
     ```
   - `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testoptions.manageddevices.emulator.gpu=swiftshader_indirect`
   - On failure, upload `app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/` and `app/build/reports/androidTests/` with `actions/upload-artifact@v4`.
   - `timeout-minutes: 45`.
5. `DEVELOPERS.md` "Local Test Runs": document `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` (no device needed, downloads an emulator image on first run) next to `connectedDebugAndroidTest`, and note that instrumented tests clear the app's database, so do not point `connectedDebugAndroidTest` at a personal phone.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` passes locally.
- After the owner pushes, both the `build` and `instrumented` jobs are green on GitHub. Record the run URL and the instrumented job's duration with `slicer note S55`.
- Temporarily break one assertion in `TrackerDaoTest`, push to a scratch branch and confirm the `instrumented` job fails; revert. (Pushing is an owner action; if not possible, skip and say so in the note.)
